text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's the Fan Appreciation Festival! The "Grand Confession Contest"
is about to begin! *honk honk* *KABOOM*!!

The "Fan Appreciation Festival," an annual event
where Umamusume fans are welcomed to the Academy.
Vodka decided to enter the entertainment contest held there as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Um! To be honest, I've always admired you.
Would you mind being friends with me first?"

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Daiwa Scarlet gets a high score
for a confession worthy of a model student!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, lying jerk...
As if you'd ever actually say it like that.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Shut up, will you...? It's a contest, so all that matters is winning. Winning!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Next up is Vodka-san.
Let's hear your confession line, please!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"‘I won't sweat the small stuff.
Trust me—and follow my lead!’"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, another super unique confession
that earns high marks!
After getting hyped up from such banter—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm thinking of talking to my fans about my future now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"You might end up getting sick of me,
but promise you'll stay on my side, okay?"

We exchange glances and give a slight nod.
The post-contest talk segment has begun.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: That was quite the earnest approach from Miss Daiwa Scarlet, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're right~♪ I'm the type who doesn't really express myself much, whether in my private life or in races, so...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Slowly closing in on the outer moat... I mean, I hope
I can steadily aim for number one, step by step."

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: And what about Vodka-san?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, before I give my thoughts on the contest,
there's something I want to tell everyone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's about... my future.
Vodka composed herself, looked around the venue, and—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"As you could tell from that performance earlier,
I just can't do things by the book."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I actually gave it a shot, too. To see if I could do it slow and steady, like Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't. I'm always driven by momentum,
and I only know how to look cool doing it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I don't see that through, there was no point in me being born.
I'd lose the very reason for being who I am.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There's no telling which race she'll enter next. She might pull a sudden 180 and leave everyone hanging.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's just who I am. I've got my own reasons,
and I can't get fired up unless it's there."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So... even if it's with a shrug of your shoulders,
would you walk beside me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let me dream.
In return, I'll give all of you a dream to believe in.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is—my real, genuine confession to all of you. ...That's all.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooooooooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Victory! Vodka-san, you won!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, this has nothing
to do with the contest anymore, right?

text_block_list.name: Male Fan A
text_block_list.text: Go, Vodka, goooooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Pull off something totally awesome again,
just like you did at the Derby!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, th-those guys are surprisingly...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, nobody's just a fan
of someone who's simply a strong Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: They're fans... of my way of life...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, with someone believing in me this much,
there's really nothing left to be afraid of.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely gonna find it at the next Victoria Mile.
My... brand new jewel.

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Vodka!
Vodka, let me dream with you too!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, me too!
Give me a dream!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What?
Whoa, w-wait up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That ain't the kind of dream I'm talkin' about!
Hey, hey, hey!
I was reminded of how much we appreciate the fans. At the same time, it seems a small few got a little too carried away.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Encore, encore!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with that cheering? An encore for the talk show?!

Vodka was startled by the sudden roar of the crowd.
With such a massive fanbase, the sheer excitement
was truly extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't a comedian,
so don't expect me to say anything funny."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, d-don't you have any good ideas?

With a quick gesture,
Vodka nodded and headed back to the stage.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I spoke my true feelings, but
someone here still hasn't spoken theirs, have they?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, you gotta show your real self too.
You're completely different from when you're in our room.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? What?"

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Oho! Does this mean we get to hear some juicy roommate secrets?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Listen up, everyone! Scarlet acts like an honor student on the outside, but deep down, she's obsessed with being number one...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be the most beloved Umamusume ever~♪
Sooo, please cheer for me, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey! I'm competing with you fair and square,
so how long are you gonna keep playing dumb?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whatever could you mean~? I have no idea~♪ But right now,
the one I want to shut up the most might be Vodka~?

The bizarre, bloodthirsty comedy routine was a massive hit with the audience.
Vodka even delivered a stellar encore.
